# mobrpg CLI — guide for AI agents

`mobrpg` is a CLI over the mobRPG world-builder REST API (Tim Dennis'
mobrpg.com), used to sync mobRPG worlds with gm-apprentice campaign vaults.
Every verb is a native Python subcommand under mobrpg/commands/; all of them
share one client (mobrpg/client.py) for environment resolution and auth.

## Install

    python3 -m pip install -e path/to/tools/mobrpg
    mobrpg --help

## Environment & auth (read before running anything)

- MOBRPG_ENV=dev|prod   Which server to hit. Default: prod. The resolved
                        target (env + BASE URL) is printed to stderr on every
                        run — never ambiguous.
- MOBRPG_TOKEN          Bearer token. Authenticates as the token owner. Treat
                        like a password. Overrides the managed config below.
- Managed credentials   Preferred: run `mobrpg auth import <credentials.csv>`
                        once to store a token in a user-level config
                        (MOBRPG_CONFIG_DIR override; ~/.config/mobrpg on POSIX,
                        %APPDATA%\mobrpg on Windows). get_access_token precedence:
                        MOBRPG_TOKEN env > managed config > MOBRPG_EMAIL/PASSWORD.
- MOBRPG_EMAIL / MOBRPG_PASSWORD   Alternative to a bearer token (local-password
                        accounts only). Works against either environment.
- Optional per-field overrides: MOBRPG_BASE, MOBRPG_CLIENT_ID, MOBRPG_REDIRECT_URI.

Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 API error; 2 bad args / no auth configured.

## Read-only vs mutating

Read-only (safe anywhere): whoami, worlds, pull, whats-new, suggestions, catalog, map, images.
Mutating (need write access; dry-run by default, add --execute to apply):
suggest, submit-batch, update, review, sync (sync only submits a suggestion on
a push/tie decision — a pull decision just overwrites the note locally).
write/link-orphans/pull-canon/adopt/relink only touch local vault files, not
the API (pull-canon and adopt read from mobRPG but only ever write locally;
relink makes no API calls at all).

Entity/event IDs live in each note's `mobrpg:` frontmatter node — the single
source of truth. There is NO sidecar crosswalk; never read or write one. A
vault whose entities already exist upstream but carry no node is linked with
`adopt` (match live elements by name → stamp nodes), never by a crosswalk.

## Commands

    mobrpg auth <import|status|refresh|logout>
                                  Manage mobRPG credentials. `import
                                  <credentials.csv>` verifies via whoami and
                                  stores a user-level token; `status` reports the
                                  configured user; `refresh` renews an expired
                                  token; `logout` removes it. Tokens are never
                                  printed. See skill reference auth-setup.md.
    mobrpg whoami                 Print the authenticated user and their worlds.
    mobrpg worlds                 (same as whoami) list visible worlds.
    mobrpg pull <world> [--out F] Import a mobRPG world into a JSON extract
                                  (default extract.json). Entry of the import
                                  pipeline; feeds `write`. The extract carries
                                  entities/events/counts plus a `types` section
                                  (creature/organization/political classifier
                                  types, bound or not) for "what's new" discovery.
    mobrpg whats-new <world> --vault <path> [--extract F] [--json]
                                  Read-only discovery report diffing mobRPG (a
                                  live pull, or a pre-pulled --extract) against the
                                  vault's mobrpg: nodes + type map: NEW entities
                                  (no linked node → pull candidates), GONE (vault
                                  nodes absent upstream → deleted/zombie notes),
                                  and NEW classifier types (from the extract's
                                  types section, not yet in the map). The pull-side
                                  companion to `sync`/`suggest` (the push side).
    mobrpg suggestions <world> [--state Pending|Accepted|Dismissed] [--correlate]
                       [--vault DIR] [--fetch-elements] [--json] [--out DIR]
                                  List suggestions by review state (the return
                                  leg of `suggest`). --correlate joins each back
                                  to its vault file (externalRef) and shows the
                                  resultElementId an Accepted one produced. Needs
                                  ReadWriteDelete on the world.
    mobrpg catalog <world> <kind> [--size N] [--names-only] [--json]
                                  List the elements of one kind (names + ids),
                                  e.g. political/type, landfeature, person. See
                                  what exists before pushing, to avoid dup Types.
    mobrpg map <init|sync|check> <world> --vault <path> [--map FILE]
                                  Generate/maintain the per-vault type mapping.
                                  init: discover mobRPG types + scan vault vocab ->
                                  propose _meta/mobrpg-map.json. sync: re-discover +
                                  merge non-destructively (preserve confirmed).
                                  check: coverage report. Read-only on mobRPG.
    mobrpg pull-canon <world> --vault <path> [--no-verify] [--execute]
                                  Pull ratified mobRPG canon down into vault
                                  mobrpg: nodes. mobRPG is canon; the vault is
                                  the working surface: accepted fills ids,
                                  accepted-after-edit/drift overwrites
                                  `determined`, dismissed records a note,
                                  deleted flags, pending leaves the vault alone.
                                  Verifies each accepted element to detect drift
                                  and deletion; --no-verify skips that pass.
                                  Scaffolds a note only for a ref that names a
                                  real vault note path under a folder the vault
                                  already has; reserved handles (rel/, desc/) and
                                  unrecognised roots are reported, never created.
    mobrpg pull-canon <world> --vault <path> --reconcile-deletions [--execute]
                                  Flag linked nodes whose element is gone from
                                  mobRPG — the write side of whats-new's GONE
                                  list. The review-queue pass only sees deletions
                                  of elements it reviewed, so an element deleted
                                  directly upstream is otherwise never reconciled.
                                  Aborts rather than act on an unreadable or
                                  empty world. Vault-write only.
    mobrpg adopt <world> --vault <path> [--map F] [--kind K] [--only S] [--execute]
                                  Stamp `mobrpg:` nodes onto vault notes that
                                  already exist upstream but carry no node —
                                  match each to exactly one live element of the
                                  same kind by normalized name (aliases too) and
                                  write an `accepted` node with the real
                                  element_id. Ambiguous (several live matches) or
                                  unmatched notes are reported, never guessed.
                                  The node-establishment path for imported / pushed
                                  vaults and the dup-safe alternative to any
                                  crosswalk. GET-only against mobRPG; dry-run
                                  without --execute.
    mobrpg relink --vault <path> --to <new-rel-path> [--from <old-rel-path>]
                  [--execute]
                                  Re-point a moved/renamed note's mobrpg
                                  external_ref to its current path, keeping
                                  element_id and recording the old ref in
                                  previous_ref. Vault-only (no API); run after
                                  renaming/moving a synced note so a re-push
                                  won't mint a duplicate. Dry-run without
                                  --execute; --from guards against relinking the
                                  wrong note.
    mobrpg update <world> <suggestionId> <update.json> [--execute]
                                  Replace a Pending suggestion's payload (PUT,
                                  whole-payload). Edits inline fields only (name,
                                  description, altNames, data e.g. Person.languages)
                                  — cannot add classifier edges; use submit-batch.
    mobrpg review <world> <suggestionId> <accept|dismiss|reinstate>
                       [--note TEXT] [--execute]
                                  GM review action on one suggestion (needs
                                  ReadWriteDelete). Dry-run without --execute.
                                  accept is irreversible; dismiss keeps the
                                  externalRef claimed (see resubmit note below).
    mobrpg write <extract.json> --out <vault-dir> [--campaign NAME]
                 [--source-doc TEXT] [--name-style plain|space]
                                  Materialize a mobRPG extract (from `pull`)
                                  into vault markdown — one file per entity,
                                  mapped to the correct folder/template/type.
    mobrpg link-orphans <extract.json> --vault <path> --out <dir>
                        [--systems NAMES] [--execute]
                                  Auto-link obvious orphan entities after an
                                  import, using conservative structural naming
                                  rules (e.g. "<System> <ROMAN>" -> part_of the
                                  system; --systems is the comma-separated list
                                  of star system names the rules apply to).
                                  Only links to targets that already exist in
                                  the vault. Writes a report; vault edits
                                  (relationships: frontmatter) gated by
                                  --execute (dry-run default).
    mobrpg sync <world> --vault <path> [--only S] [--skew SECONDS]
                [--batch-label L] [--execute]
                                  Timestamp last-writer-wins sync of every
                                  linked note's description prose against
                                  mtime / node last_synced / server
                                  lastModified. Per-note verdict is one of
                                  skip / pull / push / tie / baseline (a
                                  never-synced note with no LWW baseline —
                                  content decides instead of timestamps). A
                                  pull overwrites the note's canon prose
                                  locally (vault-only tail preserved — GM
                                  Notes plus session-bookkeeping sections by
                                  default, configurable via
                                  "vaultOnlySections" in
                                  _meta/mobrpg-map.json) and stamps
                                  last_synced; a push/tie decision never
                                  writes upstream directly — it files one
                                  reviewable UpdateElement suggestion (raw
                                  Markdown, own upd/<relpath>#<hash>
                                  externalRef) and marks the node
                                  review_state: pending until `review`
                                  adjudicates it. Notes already pending are
                                  skipped. Dry-run by default.
    mobrpg suggest <world> --vault <path> [--chapter CH] [--kind K] [--only S]
                  [--limit N] [--out DIR] [--write-back] [--include-pcs]
                  [--execute]
                                  Build the full datatype graph per vault entity
                                  (element + classifier Types via Attribute edges
                                  + reified relationship Events) and submit it as
                                  compound suggestion batches. Only needs Read
                                  access — the owner accepts/dismisses each, so no
                                  live element is created directly. PCs excluded
                                  unless --include-pcs; --write-back also writes a
                                  pending mobrpg: node into each entity's file.
    mobrpg submit-batch <world> <batch.json> [--execute]
                                  Submit a pre-built COMPOUND batch (classifier
                                  Types, Attribute edges, reified Event + Link
                                  relationships, in-batch ref/dependsOn wiring).
                                  Dry-run by default.
    mobrpg images <world> --vault <path> [--execute]
                                  Pull entity images into the vault (id->file map
                                  comes from the vault's own mobrpg: nodes).

Mutating verbs are dry-run by default; add --execute to actually write. Run
`mobrpg <command> --help` for a command's own options.

## Typical workflows

Import a world into a vault:
    export MOBRPG_TOKEN=...            # read-only, prod is fine
    mobrpg pull <worldId> --out extract.json
    mobrpg write extract.json --out /path/to/vault
    mobrpg link-orphans extract.json --vault /path/to/vault --out ./orphan_out

Push a vault chapter to mobRPG (safe: suggestions):
    export MOBRPG_TOKEN=...
    mobrpg suggest <worldId> --vault /path/to/vault --chapter chapter-2            # dry-run
    mobrpg suggest <worldId> --vault /path/to/vault --chapter chapter-2 --execute

Confirm the round-trip after a GM accepts them in mobRPG (read-only):
    mobrpg catalog <worldId> political/type                # see existing Types first
    mobrpg suggestions <worldId> --state Accepted --correlate --vault /path/to/vault
                                                            # externalRef -> vault file -> new element id

Keep a linked note's description prose in sync going forward:
    export MOBRPG_TOKEN=...
    mobrpg sync <worldId> --vault /path/to/vault            # dry-run: shows the decision table
    mobrpg sync <worldId> --vault /path/to/vault --execute  # pulls newer canon, files suggestions for newer vault edits
